part: main loop: Condition and direction, students
question: Does local Clef label queue stories at a rate and agreement with Jev that make Clef-labelled students worth training?
one_change: label 6,000 queue stories that Jev already labelled with local Clef on the 5090, headline plus teaser

baseline.model: hosted Jev dial share on the same queue stories (T111-J)

prediction.metric: share of stories given a dial by Clef
prediction.why: Jev gave 0.5163 on these stories (runs/pulse/t111/t111_label_queue.json); local Clef ran 8 items per second for two choices in earlier cards, so 6,000 stories take about 15 minutes; this card needs the owner yes for the local GPU and has not been run; pass or fail test (added after MM3-0673): go to training students on these labels only if Clef agrees with Jev on the dial for at least half of the 6,000 stories; stop and report if the share given a dial falls outside 0.40 to 0.65; the owner decides engine adoption, the loop decides the training card
